Dartas

Overview

Dartas is the baron’s son and expects to inherit Jigran. His early arrogance and boredom give way to despair as the family’s military position deteriorates. Kir’s resolve wins his trust. His recollection of a blue-stoned medallion and a village destroyed by harpies also provides a lead to Joon relics. [1, 2, 3]

Return to Jigran and Dar-Leanos

The old portal brings the travellers to the Canian side of Jigran, where Baron Virril questions their arrival amid attacks by the undead. The baron has lost Dar-Ulgorn to Firez’s forces but refuses Kir’s suggestion to seek outside help, citing his family’s pride. Kir and Kel assist the endangered settlements. They meet the baron’s son Dartas and the overworked Master Stark. Stark provides a password for Uncle Rad, a seller of sweets who secretly gathers intelligence for the baron. These local alliances make the campaign against Firez possible. [4, 5, 1, 6, 7, 8, 9]

Dartas, Kel and the duel

Dartas treats Kel as someone he is entitled to possess, insults her attachment to Kir and refuses to accept rejection. When Kir confronts him, Dartas asks what he wants in exchange for her and then calls him a coward. They duel on Death Island. Defeated and spared, Dartas admits despair over Dar-Ulgorn’s loss and his family’s future. Kir answers with his own enslavement, escape and determination to fight, winning Dartas’s respect. Kel initially believes the duel means that Kir has recognised her feelings; he disappoints her by calling it a defence of his own honour. The baron considers punishment, then accepts that Dartas needed the lesson; Kir asks him not to punish his son further. [10, 11, 12, 2, 13, 14]

The Joon cache and allies for the assault

The sealed cache supplies Kir with Joon armour, but Tui-Len warns him against relying on hatred alone. He gives him an amulet that can turn dangerous creatures into allies. Rad identifies suitable hunting grounds for a cyclops and a dragon. Their recruitment changes the military balance and answers the baron’s objection that his soldiers cannot face Firez’s necromancy in a direct assault. Virril finally orders the attack. Before the confrontation, Rad speaks of the quiet home and family he hopes to have when his secret work is finished. The cache is found in the valley Rad hopes to settle after the war. Dartas’s account of a nearby village destroyed by harpies points Kir to the rectangular amulet needed at its sealed entrance; Tui-Len supplies the remaining magical help. During the assault, Firez sends the city’s population, transformed into undead, against the Canian force. Kir must break through this army to reach the palace. [15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 3, 20, 21]
